_doc: Example --samples input for calibrate_weights.py (GOL-3201). GOL-3285: bareroot now packs into the p24x10x4 / p24x10x6 cartons, and WEIGHT_CALIBRATION ships EMPTY, so both boxes start unverified and quote the conservative full-capacity weight (p24x10x4 12 lb, p24x10x6 22 lb). `p24x10x4` here carries 3 samples (< MIN_CALIBRATION_SAMPLES) so it stays unverified; `p24x10x6` is force-conservative so it stays unverified regardless of sample count. This reproduces the published all-conservative calibration -> no change needed. Weights are lb; a sample may be a bare number or {"weight_lb": x, "count": n}.
